release: Delta Reign and the 30th Celebration Wave 4 products, 2026-11-06 + MEP promos
note: Releases newer than the upstream catalog. Card identity, numbering and rarity from the published Delta Reign card list (Serebii + YesTCG), prices are TCGplayer market as relayed by YesTCG on 2026-11-05, images from the same image service the catalog uses. Supertype/subtype/type/HP come from Serebii cards. Subtypes of Pokémon are not published in the sources read here, so they stay null rather than being guessed. The MEP Black Star Promos are added from TCGdex: identity, numbering, rarity, artwork and TCGplayer USD market prices as published there, with the four Build & Battle Box promos TCGdex omits (MEP 111-114) taken from the TCGplayer mirror tcgcsv, which publishes no illustrator or Pokédex number for them. MEP 115-118 are not imported: Bulbapedia's promo pages for them redirect to the set printings they reprint (Spritzee Perfect Order 35, Seel Perfect Order 18, Kyogre Delta Reign 26, Mega Rayquaza ex Delta Reign 84), so the products that carry them hand over those set cards. The set is the promo programme, not a booster line, so it ships no sealed product of its own; its cards exist so the 30th Celebration, Ascended Heroes and Delta Reign boxes can hand out the promo they actually contain.
